12.2.1.title: Start the response
12.2.1.description: Gather emergency details, use communications equipment, and promptly relay accurate information to dispatch.

12.2.2.title: Radio messages
12.2.2.description: Send and receive clear, complete messages; distinguish routine traffic from emergency traffic.

12.3.1.title: Pumper readiness
12.3.1.description: Inspect and operate pumper components; identify problems and address deficiencies under department procedures.

12.4.1.title: Safe apparatus travel
12.4.1.description: Use provided safety equipment when boarding, riding, and exiting; wear seat belts while moving.

12.4.2.title: Protected scene workspace
12.4.2.description: Use safety equipment and traffic controls; perform assigned tasks within the protected work area.

12.4.3.title: Establish water supply
12.4.3.description: Make secure, unobstructed connections using the applicable hydrant or drafting setup.

12.4.4.title: Operate attack streams
12.4.4.description: Engage the pump, set safety controls, maintain nozzle flow, and monitor apparatus operation.

12.4.5.title: Relay pumping
12.4.5.description: Supply the next pumper’s required flow and intake pressure through a line 2½ inches or larger.

12.4.6.title: Foam application
12.4.6.description: Connect and operate foam equipment to deliver correctly proportioned foam.

12.4.7.title: Support building systems
12.4.7.description: Provide sprinkler or standpipe systems with the required water volume and pressure.
